Ozgur wakes up in the dead of night, he remembers a dream he had once, not too long ago. Koruha chirps lightly in Ozgur's dream. She sings a soothing song. And the song tells the story of two brothers. Their bond moves to betrayal and yet the tone of the song stays sweet. And as it crescendos and falls they age a life time separate from one another by decades of offense. And then again the chorus repeats. Once again they are young. And the Ozgur sees them, his heart heavy for the future that they will see. And the song of Koruha which springs from that heaviness gives him kindness and compassion, service and hope. He sings Koruha's song and the brothers are moved. Forgiven. Forgotten. Freed from a destiny full of regrets. 
After a few minutes, Ozgur returns to restless slumber.
